outputs.name: blog
outputs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: a finished raster editorial blog card for a fictional Korean bedding brand, for placement directly into a website portrait slot.
Input image: reference image of RUUM bedding, used only for matching subject, warm mood, material textures and palette. Recreate and recompose as a new complete finished blog card.
Canvas: EXACT 1:2 portrait aspect ratio, target 1024 pixels wide × 2048 pixels high. Single card edge-to-edge filling the canvas. White article surface, lime green masthead, dark readable Korean typography. The outer image bounds ARE the blog card bounds. No outer border, no surrounding background, no external padding, no device mockup.
Composition: compact restrained Korean editorial design with a full-width lime masthead at the very top, 'blog' clearly rendered; a small label '루움의 리빙노트'; a prominent two-line headline '이불 고를 때' then '꼭 확인할 3가지'; deck '소재 · 계절 · 세탁'. A large editorial photograph beneath the headline occupies a generous part of the card: a realistically photographed warm sunlit bed with ivory bedding, a moss-green throw and terracotta cushion, with beautiful tactile cotton and linen details, same restful atmosphere as reference. Keep the photograph free of words. Below the photograph, three compact numbered editorial rows in dark charcoal, with clear hierarchy between bold row titles and readable descriptions. The page should feel like a polished compact Korean blog article, all content fitted harmoniously into the tall card. Do not use tiny filler text.
Text, verbatim, with accurate clear Korean glyphs:
Masthead: 'blog'
Small label: '루움의 리빙노트'
Main headline on two lines: '이불 고를 때\n꼭 확인할 3가지'
Deck: '소재 · 계절 · 세탁'
Row 1 title: '01 피부에 닿는 소재부터'
Row 1 body: '면·리넨 등 겉감의 소재와 혼용률을 확인하세요.'
Row 2 title: '02 우리 집 온도에 맞는 두께'
Row 2 body: '침실 온도와 수면 환경에 맞는 두께를 고르세요.'
Row 3 title: '03 세탁까지 편해야 좋은 이불'
Row 3 body: '제품의 세탁 표시와 건조 방법을 확인하세요.'
Bottom: '내 생활에 맞는 침구를 찾는 기준, 루움'
Constraints: exactly one finished blog card, no additional words, no fabricated metrics, no review counts, no external logos, no watermark, no repeating headline inside the photograph, no collage of cards. All rows and footer must be complete and within the canvas. Brand is fictional. Make this precisely a tall 1:2 card, not a square or conventional 2:3 poster.

outputs.name: campaign
outputs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: full-bleed campaign photograph for a fictional Korean bakery brand, for a tall portrait website slot.
Input image: reference MORNING OVEN bakery sidewalk A-frame advertisement; keep the established yellow/red campaign palette, wooden sign material, appetizing sandwich-and-iced-coffee subject, realistic bakery context. Recreate the photograph with a new composition naturally fitted to EXACT 1:2 portrait aspect ratio, target 1024 pixels wide × 2048 pixels high.
Scene: a welcoming bakery sidewalk with warm wood framed glass door and warmly lit pastry display behind. Realistic stone sidewalk. In the foreground, a tall natural wooden A-frame sign, fully visible including both feet and entire top and headline, close to the camera and filling roughly 80 percent of image width. The tall sign should take up most of the height while leaving enough actual photographed storefront above and real sidewalk below for a natural 1:2 composition. All four image edges must be photographic scene; no letterboxing and no blank borders.
Sign advertisement: vivid warm yellow background, bold red Korean main headline. At top, fictional bakery brand '모닝오븐' with 'MORNING OVEN' below. Main headline exactly '점심 고민 끝'. Supporting line exactly '샌드위치 + 아메리카노'. Beneath the text, a very appetizing generous chicken-and-lettuce sandwich with tomato and cheese, beside a clear cup of iced americano with realistic ice and condensation. Rich detailed bread crust, fresh green lettuce, warm chicken. Preserve realistic print-on-sign appearance, legible Korean glyphs, natural perspective, accurate wood grain and contact shadows.
Text, verbatim, and no other text:
'모닝오븐'
'MORNING OVEN'
'점심 고민 끝'
'샌드위치 + 아메리카노'
Style: polished believable lifestyle advertising photography, warm daylight, realistic materials, slight depth separation from bakery interior, clean professional campaign rendering.
Constraints: exactly one cohesive photograph, no device mockup, no card frame around the image, no collage, no white border, no artificial stretching, no cropped sign feet or headline, no extra slogans, no prices, no unrequested marketing claims, no watermark. This must be a naturally recomposed full-bleed 1:2 tall photograph, not the original image placed inside a taller blank canvas.
